biography.value:
Description

Multiple angry snake-like heads rise from the sleek, serpentine body of this terrifying monster.

Defense

AC 15, touch 9; flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +6 natural, -2 size)

hp 59 (5d12+25); Fast Healing 6 [3 heads]

Fort +9, Ref +7, Will +6

Immune Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Ice 5, Fire 5, Water 5

Offense

Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft.

Melee 3 Bites +7 (2d6+4), Tail Slap +2 (1d8+2)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Pounce, 3 Breath Weapons (15-ft. cone, DC 20, 2d4 fire, ice, or water, usable every 1d4 rounds)

Statistics

Str 18, Dex 12, Con 20, Int 2, Wis 11, Cha 9

Base Atk +5; CMB +11; CMD 22 (can't be trip)

Feats Combat Reflexes, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes

Skills Perception +10, Swim +11; Racial Modifier +2 Perception

SQ Hydra Traits, Fast Healing

traits.fastHealing: 2 per intact head; none with one head

description.value: A hydra's fast healing ability is double to its current number of heads. A hydra loses all fast healing when it is reduced to a single head.

effect: Once each round; current head counters yield 6, 4 or 0 HP.

description.value: Any critical hit has a 75% chance to sever a head also you cannot sever the last head but a hydra loses its fast healing if they only have one head remaining. A hydra can't attack with a severed head, but takes no other penalties. A hydra also loses one of its breath weapons per head lost.

effect: On a confirmed critical roll [[1d100]]; on 01-75 spend one intact head. Never sever the last head.

description.value: When a hydra makes a charge, it can make a full attack.

effect: On a charge, make the full current-head bite routine and tail slap; apply charge modifiers once.

description.value: One intact head. Spend only after a critical hit successfully severs this head; the final head cannot be severed.

effect: Sever this head. Its bite and breath cease to be available.
Only the corresponding intact head can breathe.
